settings.title: Rest machining with two finishing contours

parameters.name: Rough, right-hand tool
parameters.comment: Rough turning with the right-hand V insert. The wall behind the pocket is steeper than the back of the insert, so a wedge of material stays beside it.

parameters.name: Rest, left-hand tool
parameters.comment: The left-hand tool works from the chuck side towards the front. It cuts what it can reach with its body clear of the part and leaves the rest.

parameters.name: Finish, right-hand tool, cutter compensation
parameters.comment: Finishing only: its own, shortened contour (the part of the contour this tool can reach). The finishing allowance of 1 mm keeps the block from roughing again, the pass itself follows the contour.

parameters.name: Finish, left-hand tool, cutter compensation
parameters.comment: Finishing only: its own, shortened contour. The finishing allowance of 1 mm keeps the block from roughing again, the pass itself follows the contour.
